overall_notes: All 30 RFx lines quoted, vendor used the buyer's own line numbering (L01-L30) and abridged descriptions consistent with RFx specs; matching is therefore high-confidence. KEY COMMERCIAL RISKS: (1) all prices are in USD, not INR - Indian invoicing at RBI reference rate on invoice date, so FX risk sits with the buyer and no conversion has been applied here; (2) prices are EXW Chakan, Pune, not delivered Bhiwandi - freight extra at INR 14,500 per 32 ft MXL truck (7 MT payload) at actuals; (3) validity only 90 days vs 180 required, plus a quarterly kraft-index price-variation clause beyond +/-4%; (4) LD cap 3% vs 5% required; (5) tooling (plates/dies) charged at cost extra, MOQ 2 MT per release; (6) 3.5% annual volume rebate only if off-take exceeds USD 350,000 - conditional and paid in arrears; (7) the attached ISO 9001:2015 certificate expired 31 March 2026 and is therefore NOT valid on the bid due date, despite the Q01 claim - a qualification issue to raise with the vendor; (8) L21/L22 rolls quoted per running metre rather than per roll (vendor states roll length 50 m); (9) L06 remark recommends a BF 20 alternative (RFx spec BF 22) with price on request - no alternative price given; (10) Q02 capacity of 1,200 MT/month is group India figure, Chakan plant alone is 850 MT/month.
